name: magtouch_paper1_anchor_placement_holdout_20261113
test_mode: New coordinates within the original three spatial holdout regions; frozen before forward results; four strata with three points each. A small independent confirmation within those regions, not evidence for unseen regions in general.

anchors.method: same periodic Delaunay for all unstructured arms
anchors.targeting: First 20 per each of four strata, cycle strata among each nearest 90 pool candidates to the pre-existing holdout rectangle; within allowed set select the greatest distance from already selected anchors. Complete to 147 using global farthest-point sampling. Uniform uses global farthest-point sampling to 147. All distances use periodic unwrapped coordinates. First uniform anchor is farthest from fixed unwrapped reference (phi=0, meridian=60 mm). Ties use load ID ordering.

endpoints.primary: Same-site delta in 3D errors; summarize each seed and pooled with site denominators; paired geometric coverage, 3D mean/P95/max, azimuth, meridian, cap angle, seam errors, raw and amplitude-fitted relative field errors
endpoints.rule: A targeted placement improvement requires no loss of coverage, lower pooled common-site mean and P95, and no increase in per-region mean. Also report worst point and separate per-region sample counts. For claims distinguish limited independent confirmation from whole-region precision.
